questions: Should the bar chart always include bars for all items in the predefined items list, even if their count is zero, or should it omit zero-count items?
Is the order of bars in the chart required to match the order of items in the predefined items list, or can it be sorted differently (e.g., by frequency)?
Should the function handle non-string items in the input lists (e.g., numbers, None) or assume all items are strings?
Is the function expected to modify the input lists (a, b) or the items parameter in any way, or treat them as immutable?
Should the bar chart's title, axis labels, or colors be customizable via additional parameters, or are they fixed as in the reference?
If the predefined items list is empty, should the function produce an empty chart, raise an error, or handle it differently?
Are the input lists (a, b) guaranteed to be flat lists, or could they contain nested structures that need flattening?
Should the function ensure the bar chart is displayed (e.g., via plt.show()) or only return the Axes object without displaying?
